cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.4.2.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/Users/davi/Documents/Git/PlayHaumea/Haumea/3rdparty/SDL2/cmake")
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS [[  -fno-rtti -fno-exceptions -fcolor-diagnostics -finput-charset=UTF-8 -fexec-charset=UTF-8 -g -fno-strict-aliasing -fno-omit-frame-pointer -Wall -fmessage-length=0 -idirafter "/Users/davi/Documents/Git/PlayHaumea/Haumea/3rdparty/SDL2/src/video/khronos"]])
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-DHAVE_GCC_NO_STRICT_ALIASING]==] [==[-fno-strict-aliasing]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0181 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0210 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0214 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/Users/davi/Documents/Git/PlayHaumea/Haumea/build_ios_verify/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-EJVbAC")
add_executable(cmTC_be32b)
target_sources(cmTC_be32b PRIVATE
  "/Users/davi/Documents/Git/PlayHaumea/Haumea/build_ios_verify/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-EJVbAC/src.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_be32b_$<UPPER_CASE:$<CONFIG>>_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_be32b>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_be32b ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
